catalog.method: Plain GET (Dalvik/2.1.0 Android 14 UA), no auth, on 3 paired THAIVPN2 envelopes at one prefix: config.json + modes.json + policy.json. Each envelope: 5-layer AES-256-GCM + HMAC-SHA256 layer keys + ECDSA P-256 signature (verified when present). Bridge merges config (minus updates block) + modes + policy.
catalog.notes: Modes rev 10009 (14 modes); policy rev 10007. The config updates block (download API / locator) is stripped from the result, per Pedro's rule; the live catalog re-fetch is byte-identical to the delivered sample except that block.

files.method: TVC codec: salt || HMAC-masked AES-256-GCM layers over rawDeflate(profile JSON); per-scheme 32-byte keys, hyb:// reuses sray://; variants locked/normal/legacy tried in order. Raw bytes or base64url text.
